prefixes./api/accounts: Switching between the accounts signed in on one browser: its session cookies, not a credential a script holds.
prefixes./api/v1/apps/: The app platform: whether the SDKs cover it is an open scope decision.
prefixes./api/auth/passkey/: Passkey sign-in: a WebAuthn ceremony between the browser and the authenticator.
prefixes./api/me/passkeys: Registering and naming passkeys: a WebAuthn ceremony in the browser.
prefixes./api/me/mfa: A person's own second factor, enrolled and reset in the browser with the authenticator at hand.
prefixes./api/me/email: Changing the sign-in email: confirmed by a link sent to the person's inbox.
prefixes./api/unsubscribe: The email footer's one-click unsubscribe, keyed by the link's own token.

routes.DELETE /api/me: Closing one's own account: a person's decision, made signed in to the web app.
routes.POST /api/me/password: The password form, behind the person's current password.
routes.GET /api/share/{token}/attachments/{atta: An attachment inside a shared snapshot, fetched by the page that renders the snapshot.
